patch_description: Stack two identical canonical blocks with full parameter sharing across both repetitions. This maintains the 3-parameter economy (ry_shared, rz_shared for pre-entanglement, and rz_shared for post-entanglement) while doubling circuit depth to ~70. The added representational capacity should accelerate convergence from 90 steps back toward the 30-60 range, while preserving the perfect accuracy and parameter efficiency gains. The recommendation directly suggests this approach as a way to "probe whether increased expressivity via extra layers improves robustness or accelerates convergence."
